_about: views: the photos of the street (calibration as described below), used by the map and by scripts/centre_view.py. centre_views: AI images of the street from the centre of the road (scripts/centre_view.py), the views of street.html; lat/lon is the road centre, horizon_y and vanishing_x where the street lines meet, focal_px assumes a 70 degree horizontal field of view. Photo calibration: horizon_y and vanishing_x are where the street's parallel lines (kerbs, building base, lane markings) meet; street_bearing_deg is the street direction from OSM (way 81083900), towards the vanishing point. ground: polygon where objects can be placed. foreground: photo parts in front of anything placed.
